title: His pianist mother and godmother Lilia Perez, sister of Manuel Perez
summary: His mother was a non-professional pianist who wanted him to play violin. Manuel Perez's sister Lilia, his godmother, is the last living Perez.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Can you tell about your parents? Did they play instruments?

My mother was a pianist. She was a very good pianist, but not professionally. She didn't play professionally. And she wanted me to play violin, but I never did like violin. And what made me like trumpet or cornet, as I might say, was Manuel Perez. Manuel Perez's sister, she's the only one that's living today. Her name is Lilia Perez. She's my godmother.
Do you know where she's living about?
Yes, she lives at 1136 Two Row Strait. She's the only one living in the Perez family today.
Is she older or younger than Manuel?
